definitions.explanation: The money needed for daily life necessities such as food, housing, and utilities.

examples.japanese: {生活費|せいかつひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧。
examples.english: The living expenses are not enough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生活費|せいかつひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The cost of living in Tokyo is high.

examples.japanese: ⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{稼|かせ}いだ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧{生活費|せいかつひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Almost all the money I earn from my part-time job goes toward living expenses.

notes:
{生活費|せいかつひ} is a compound of ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (life, living) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense, cost). The ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ suffix appears in many expense-related words.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧: food expenses
- ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧: transportation costs
- ⟦{光熱費|こうねつひ}→光熱費：08244_kounetsuhi⟧: utility costs (electricity, gas)
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧: rent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活費|せいかつひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧: to earn a living
- {生活費|せいかつひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to cut living costs
- {生活費|せいかつひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: living expenses add up
